story_overview: At the Stillwater Stampede Rodeo, a night of entertainment turns to chaos when a horse injures its rider, sparking a mass panic. Amid the fleeing crowds, Jordan is pursued, while Dakota and Hailey are chased through the fairgrounds. The pair eventually escape and flee to the safety of the Westway Motel.
